english.title: Drive / leave a vehicle which did not comply with lighting requirements applying to that part of Stansted Airport
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..)

(A)_[drove]_
(B)_[left]_

a vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), at **(..SPECIFY THE LOCATION..) at Stansted Airport which did not comply with the lighting requirements which apply on that part of the Airport to which the road traffic enactments apply in that **(..SPECIFY THE MANNER OF THE NON-COMPLIANCE..)
english.legislation: Contrary to byelaws 6(2) and 2(2) of the Stansted Airport - London Byelaws, 1996 and section 63 of the Airports Act 1986.

english.notes: This Byelaw applies to any part of the Airport to which the road traffic enactments do not apply unless the permission of the Airport Company has first been obtained or unless the act is performed by a person acting with lawful authority or excuse.
